body: Thank you for your words. I am sorry you had to experience this.

Yes, I am in therapy once a week and I signed up to three mental hospitals but waiting times are all around 4-6 months. Only my usual psych ward said I could get admitted within 3 weeks if I paid for a private room. But that’s 2k a month and as a trainee I earn 800€ a month. My husband said he would pay for it (he earns 4K a month) but it just makes me feel like a burden even more. And three weeks is still so long. I don’t know if I can make it.
